description: A chess game box sits on a clear tabletop, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is brought in above it. The right hand holds the tape measure and pulls the yellow tape out, first stretching it across the length of the chess box while the left hand pins the far end, then retracts and repositions it to measure the width with the tape held more upright before letting the tape slide back into the case; the tape measure is a right-hand object throughout, while the chess box is touched and steadied by the left hand.
